fact: On 4 August 2026 the Minister of Digital Economy presented and had validated the PSEN and the national AI strategy at a government ceremony, announcing their submission to the Council of Ministers for adoption in the following days, and that action plans, an interministerial steering mechanism and a monitoring and evaluation system were still to be put in place.
title: RDC : S.E Augustin Kibassa lance la Politique sectorielle de l'économie numérique et la Stratégie nationale de l'IA
